incidents.summary: Austria’s Supreme Court declared 81 Wizz Air contract clauses illegal following a consumer-protection challenge to terms that had disadvantaged passengers since 2019.

sources.title: OGH ruling: against Wizz Air: practices and clauses declared illegal – Aviation.Direct
sources.quote: The Chamber of Labor (AK) had attacked a total of 88 clauses in the Wizz Air conditions of carriage and the Wizz Account, 81 of which were declared illegal.

sources.title: OGH ruling: against Wizz Air: practices and clauses declared illegal – Aviation.Direct
sources.quote: The consumer protection organization Arbeiterkammer (AK) successfully filed a lawsuit against the unclear and partly hidden contract terms that had disadvantaged passengers in Austria since 2019.

incidents.summary: UK Civil Aviation Authority enforcement over Wizz Air’s passenger-rights failures resulted in £1.24 million in refunds after the airline reviewed previously assessed claims.

sources.title: Regulator's enforcement action sees over ...
sources.quote: Enforcement action against Wizz Air has led to £1.24 million being refunded to passengers the UK Civil Aviation Authority has announced.

sources.title: Regulator's enforcement action sees over ...
sources.quote: The undertakings required Wizz Air to make changes to its policies to ensure that in future it consistently complies with its re-routing and care obligations.

sources.title: Regulator's enforcement action sees over ...
sources.quote: The airline cooperated with the action and has now completed its review of claims. This has led to more than 25,000 claims being re-examined, and additional payments given in around 6,000 cases.

incidents.summary: Hungary’s competition authority fined Wizz Air €770,000 for misleading communication about automatic check-in and steering consumers toward more expensive packages.

sources.title: Hungary's competition watchdog fines Wizz Air for misleading ...
sources.quote: Hungary's competition watchdog has imposed a fine of 770,000 euros ($839,916) on Wizz Air(WIZZ.L), opens new tab for misleading communication, the authority said on its website on Saturday.

sources.title: Hungary's competition watchdog fines Wizz Air for misleading ...
sources.quote: Hungary's competition authority said Wizz Air breached professional due diligence and was misleading in how it described its automatic check-in service and pushed consumers towards more expensive packages.

incidents.summary: The European Transport Workers’ Federation reported that a leaked Wizz Air management meeting revealed discriminatory and anti-worker criteria for selecting pilots for dismissal during the COVID-19 crisis.

sources.title: “Now is the time to clean up the airline” – internal leak exposes Wizz Air anti-worker practices | ETF Europe
sources.quote: management saw the COVID-19 crisis as the opportunity to “clean up the airline” by using discriminatory and anti-worker criteria in deciding which pilots to dismiss.

sources.title: “Now is the time to clean up the airline” – internal leak exposes Wizz Air anti-worker practices | ETF Europe
sources.quote: In the meeting, a senior Wizz Air manager tells base captains that 250 pilots need to be dismissed shortly and that after stopping the training of 150 pilots, they need to come up with a list of another 100.

positives: ClimatePartner reports that its collaboration with Wizz Air supports consistent carbon calculations aligned with current standards.
